title: Fayya le qamiidak caacay fiyne duunes
intro: ucsub dadalta qasriino acwa fayyale maqar kee qeedaalisso sinni xisne. fidin, maynaqul tan qanxixitteh fanat daffeyte, ta ayyunti horizon xagteh tan kaxxa astooti fayya hayte. Uxih kaxxiina ramid beeh, Yallih qibaadah dubuk yandabben seeco saduh garayte. macaay kataytam raqtem maabitina quukumteh caacay isih.
clues: Nanu Nuuc ummattak lakal temeete caylale agatak sugne, kaxxa giclo kee maqar luk barkat luk sugne.
Nanu fayyale kalqatittee kee hawweenaani kulli fayyale aracal dubuk dagar diig kee kaxxiinih xisne.
nanu kaxxiinisneh, iyyi nek caylale cayla, kee nanu racmatta sinnim qanxaffe luk abne.
Nanu ninni farmoyti Huud qaku le dirable num axcuk yalla cabtaay nee yaabe waqdi cinneh.
Nanu maabitina anqasak sugnem kee usug numma yaabe kaa tekkek usug meysiiseh yan digaala nel kah baahannah kaa gexkalitne.
Nanu naqabut finqisneh, malcina bar kee bacra ayroh gideh, palmi cooxuk boodoh innal radde.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
